description.value:
Two weapons, or one weapon and one set of jaws. You and your Feral Bond both go for the throat at once.

SIGNATURE — reduced penalty when making a second attack against your Marked quarry the same turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: Real analog: Ranger's Flurry Hunter's-Edge classfeature (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/flurry.json) is the same shape (a MAP discount vs. hunted prey) — buildable once the Mark exists and this card states its actual discount. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
